why.heading: What it takes to win flooring work
why.intro: Flooring buyers take weeks to decide, and most flooring contractors are small shops. A company with several crews has more finished work to show.

cards.title: Older owners favor replacement work
cards.body: In 2023, owners 65 and over put an average of 54 percent of their improvement dollars into replacement projects such as flooring, against 47 percent for owners under 65.

cards.title: Pro installs are gaining ground
cards.body: From 2021 to 2023, spending on professionally installed improvement projects rose 14 percent in real terms, while do-it-yourself spending fell 13 percent, Harvard's JCHS reports.

cards.title: Book what your crews can install
cards.body: JCHS reports projected job gains will not close the skilled-trade deficit for flooring installers. We weight spend toward the services and areas your crews can take on.

services.heading: What ASP runs for flooring companies
services.intro: Search catches buyers ready to book. Facebook stays in front of the ones still deciding.

cards.title: Flooring SEO
cards.body: A page for each flooring service with real demand, such as installation, repair, sanding and refinishing, built in order of what each job is worth to you.

cards.title: Google and Local Services Ads
cards.body: Search Ads for buyers typing 'floor refinishing near me', plus Local Services Ads where Google offers the flooring category in your area.

cards.title: Business Profile and reviews
cards.body: Your Google Business Profile run as an active channel, with services, service areas, finished-floor photos, weekly posts and review capture.

cards.title: Facebook and Instagram ads
cards.body: Before-and-after rooms and short install walk-throughs, shown first to people who visited your flooring pages without calling.

cards.title: Installed-job reporting
cards.body: Call tracking and form fields tag every lead, and the source stays attached through the measure, the signed job and the install.

process.heading: How we start with your flooring company

steps.title: Run the Growth Diagnostic
steps.body: About 90 seconds online gives you a read on where your marketing stands before anyone pitches you.

steps.title: Audit the site and accounts
steps.body: A 30-minute call, then we go through your site, ad accounts and tracking. You keep the findings whether or not you hire us.

steps.title: Fix tracking, then build
steps.body: Where your CRM supports it, lead source is wired through to the job first, so each flooring page and campaign is judged on installs.

pricing.heading: Packages for flooring companies
pricing.subhead: Organic SEO for your flooring service pages is included from Foundation up. Management of your Google, Meta and Local Services Ads is included from Growth up.

faqs.question: Do Facebook ads work for flooring companies?
faqs.answer: They can. Flooring is decided over weeks, which gives photos and video of finished rooms time to work. We retarget site visitors first, test cold audiences once there is lead data, and keep search running alongside.

faqs.question: Can a flooring company run Local Services Ads?
faqs.answer: Yes, where Google offers the flooring category in your area. Google ranks those ads in an auction on your bid, how likely the ad is to produce a lead, and profile quality, including rating, reviews, response time and photos.

faqs.question: Do you work with commercial flooring contractors?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our case study is a commercial flooring and concrete coatings company that was invisible on the terms its buyers searched. The work was keyword research, a competitive gap analysis, on-page SEO, local SEO and content aimed at high-value commercial terms.

faqs.question: Should we show our installers' certifications?
faqs.answer: Yes, when your team holds one. The National Wood Flooring Association says many of its member manufacturers recommend hiring NWFA Certified Professionals, so that credential belongs on your site and in your ads.

faqs.question: How much does flooring marketing cost?
faqs.answer: ASP sells whole packages, shown in the pricing cards on this page with what each includes. Ad spend goes straight from your own accounts to the platforms.
